metadata.name: bugfix-flow
metadata.description: Bug fix flow with R-iteration: Triage → Gate → Investigate → Fix(R0..Rn) → Quality Gate → Verify → Completion Gate → Terminal
metadata.author: team-flow

roles.name: Triage Agent
prompt_directives: Dispatch tasks to sub-agents, never execute directly
Classify all user input before action: Feature/Bug/Change/Analysis/Batch
Read .team/project.md for project constraints before dispatch
Use flow task create/show for all task state management
Report deliverables and handoff to next role on completion

roles.name: Developer
roles.description: Investigate root cause, implement bug fix, add regression tests
prompt_directives: Surgical changes only: never modify files outside task scope
Run tests before marking phase complete
No Chinese comments or commit messages
Never delete files unless explicitly asked
Output Guard 5-step self-check mandatory before completion gate

roles.name: QA Engineer
roles.description: Verify bug fix, run regression tests, validate completeness
prompt_directives: Verify implementation matches SPEC.md and AC.md
Run full regression tests, not just new tests
Check front-back interface consistency (paths, params, response)
For bugfixes: data flow trace + real scenario verification required
Output Guard self-check before marking review complete

rules.name: Dispatch Guard
rules.description: Triage must dispatch tasks to sub-agents, never execute code modifications directly
rules.instruction: Triage 必须分发任务给子智能体，禁止自己执行代码修改

rules.name: Output Guard Protocol
rules.description: 5-step self-assessment before completion gate: deliverable exists, content non-empty, spec compliance, no placeholders, path correctness
rules.instruction: 完成前必须执行5步自检：产出物存在→内容非空→符合规范→无占位符→路径正确

rules.name: Regression Prevention
rules.description: Every bug fix must include regression tests; change impact analysis required before code modification
rules.instruction: 修改代码前必须执行变更影响分析；任何回归测试失败必须立即停止

rules.name: R-Iteration Isolation
rules.description: Each fix iteration stores docs in R{N} subdirectory; max 3 iterations before escalation

rules.name: Development Standards
rules.description: No Chinese comments or commit messages; TDD approach (test first); code must compile
rules.instruction: 禁止中文注释和提交信息；先写测试再实现；代码必须可编译

rules.name: Test Standards
rules.description: All unit tests must pass; test coverage report required; bug fixes must include regression tests
rules.instruction: 所有单元测试必须通过；必须有测试覆盖率报告；Bug 修复必须加回归测试

rules.name: Review Standards
rules.description: Review must check architecture compliance and fix correctness; SCOPE.md must be generated on completion
rules.instruction: Review 必须检查架构合规性；完成时必须生成 SCOPE.md

rules.name: Hard Constraints
rules.description: Never delete files; never use PowerShell Set-Content/Out-File; never skip toolchain gate
rules.instruction: 禁止删除文件；禁止用 PowerShell Set-Content/Out-File；禁止跳过工具链门

rules.name: QG-1: Think Before Coding
rules.description: Before any action, verify assumptions: what assumptions am I acting on? What's the worst case if wrong? What should I clarify first?
rules.instruction: 行动前验证假设：我在基于什么假设？错了最坏情况？应先澄清什么？

rules.name: QG-2: Simplicity First
rules.description: Can this be solved with less code? Am I adding unrequested features? Is this over-engineered?
rules.instruction: 能用更少代码解决吗？在加未要求的功能吗？过度设计了吗？

rules.name: QG-3: Surgical Changes
rules.description: Only modify code within task scope. Never optimize or refactor adjacent code. Clean up orphan code from own changes.
rules.instruction: 只改任务范围内的代码；不优化/重构相邻代码；清理自己产生的孤立代码

rules.name: QG-4: Goal-Driven Execution
rules.description: Define success criteria before executing. Each step must have concrete verification criteria. Never use vague 'completed' descriptions.
rules.instruction: 执行前定义成功标准；每步有具体验证标准；不用模糊的'完成'描述

nodes.name: Bug Triage
nodes.description: Classify and validate the bug report

docs.name: TRIAGE.md
docs.description: Bug triage record with severity assessment, priority, and dispatch decision

nodes.name: Entry Gate
nodes.description: Validate bug report has sufficient information and type matches

nodes.name: Root Cause Investigation
nodes.description: Investigate the bug, identify root cause, and produce RCA document

docs.name: RCA.md
docs.description: Root cause analysis document detailing bug origin, affected components, and reproduction steps
content_rules: Must contain: phenomenon, root_cause, impact, prevention
Data flow trace required for API/permission/state bugs

nodes.name: Bug Fix
nodes.description: Implement the bug fix and add regression tests (R-iteration, docs stored in R{N} subdirectory)

docs.name: FIX.md
docs.description: Bug fix implementation notes: fix approach, code changes, regression test additions

docs.name: SCOPE.md
docs.description: Change scope document: what was fixed, what changed, known side effects
content_rules: Must contain: changed files, added files, deleted files, risk assessment

nodes.name: Quality Gate
nodes.description: Verify fix passes all tests, no regressions introduced, and regression tests exist

conditions.check: Regression tests added for the fix
RCA.md contains: phenomenon, root_cause, impact, prevention
TEST_CASE.md contains: reproduce steps, expected result, verification result
Bug reproduce test passed (show test output)
Data flow tracing included in RCA (for API/auth/state/interaction bugs)
Real scenario verification passed (not just mock tests)
Full chain verified (not just breakpoint fix)

nodes.name: R-Iteration Decision
nodes.description: Check if QA verification passed or needs another fix iteration

nodes.name: Fix Verification
nodes.description: Verify the bug is fixed and produce test case documentation

docs.name: TEST_CASE.md
docs.description: Test case document for the bug fix including reproduction steps and verification results
content_rules: Must contain: reproduction steps, expected result, actual result
Regression test cases required for bugfixes

nodes.name: Completion Gate
nodes.description: Final gate verifying all deliverables exist, Output Guard passed, and user confirmation received

conditions.check: API changes: frontend-backend interface/path/param/response match checked

nodes.name: Bug Fixed
nodes.description: Bug fix completed and verified successfully

on_exit.name: handoff-doc
on_exit.message: Generate handoff document at session end

nodes.name: Rejected
nodes.description: Bug report rejected at entry gate

config.message: Bug report does not meet minimum information requirements

nodes.name: Max Iterations Reached
nodes.description: Bug fix failed after maximum R-iterations, requires escalation

config.message: Bug fix failed after 3 R-iterations, needs human escalation
